edge_artifact_verification.verification_scope: Remote edge files versus their excluded unredacted local copies before repository redaction

known_anomalies.description: A read-only git fsck --full --no-reflogs --unreachable integrity scan ran on the car for 22.7 seconds while the application condition was active.
known_anomalies.final_condition_maximum: 2263.904662 ms at sequence 613 and 2026-08-15T17:39:03.122809Z, outside the integrity-scan window
known_anomalies.handling: Retain and include every row. Do not filter, replace, or silently retry. Qualify the affected window and use the recorded host telemetry when interpreting tails; the final condition maximum occurred outside this window.

measurement_boundary_correction.accepted_row_rule: A sender row is accepted only after every outside-timed comparison passes; the edge already validated the complete request payload length and CRC32 before emitting the acknowledgment.
measurement_boundary_correction.applies_to: all preflight-smoke and full-sweep raw TCP/MQTT sender rows in this run
measurement_boundary_correction.declared_timing_boundary: immediately before first framed TCP or MQTT byte is sent through complete correlated application-acknowledgment validation
measurement_boundary_correction.implemented_timing_end: time.monotonic_ns immediately after the complete application acknowledgment has been received and parsed for exact frame length, magic, and protocol version
measurement_boundary_correction.implemented_timing_start: time.monotonic_ns immediately before the first framed TCP length prefix or complete MQTT PUBLISH packet is passed to sendall
measurement_boundary_correction.result_interpretation: Use rtt_ms as monotonic complete-application-acknowledgment receipt-and-parse RTT. Do not claim that the subsequent local correlation comparisons are included in rtt_ms.
